units.title: Act: Confirm config.go and the example YAML hold no worker keys
Act: Confirm cmd/server/main.go reads only kept config fields
Verify: Config carries no worker or execution keys unit tests

tests.name: TestConfig_HasNoWorkerFields
tests.title: Config struct has exactly the eight sections and no worker or execution field
tests.scenario: Given the Config struct type, when its fields are enumerated, then the set equals Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin and Round

tests.name: TestExampleYAML_TopLevelKeys
tests.title: Example config has exactly the eight top-level keys and no worker key
tests.scenario: Given backend/configs/config.example.yaml, when it is unmarshalled into map[string]any, then its keys are exactly admin, auth, contribution, git, hosting, round, server and storage

tests.name: TestLoadFS_IgnoresWorkerSection
tests.title: Loading a config with a worker section ignores it and still reads the auth secret
tests.scenario: Given a YAML file with auth.token_secret 's' and a worker block, when LoadFS is called, then it returns no error and Auth.TokenSecret is 's'

units.title: Verify: Remaining config keys load and cmd uses no removed key unit tests

tests.name: TestLoad_ExampleConfig
tests.title: loads config.example.yaml with the documented server address, round duration and prompt limit
tests.scenario: Given backend/configs/config.example.yaml, when Load reads it, then no error, Server.Addr is ":8080", Round.Duration is 24h and Contribution.MaxPromptLen is 500

tests.name: TestLoadFS_MinimalDefaults
tests.title: fills scheduler interval, content dir and rate limit defaults from a minimal config
tests.scenario: Given YAML containing only auth.token_secret and a getenv returning empty strings, when LoadFS is called, then Round.SchedulerInterval is 30s, Storage.ContentDir is "game/content" and Contribution.RateMax is 3

tests.name: TestNoWorkerConfigReferences
tests.title: no Go source in the server package or cmd/server references removed worker config keys
tests.scenario: Given the *.go files under ../server and ../../cmd/server (excluding removed_code_test.go), when each is read, then none contains cfg.Worker, WorkRoot, MaxBudget or AutoPublish

units.title: REQ · Config structs, example YAML and cmd wiring contain no worker or execution keys
REQ · Config loading still works for the remaining keys and no code reads a removed key
Evidence: Config worker-key removal unit tests pass
